# Third-party notices

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-third-party-notices.py from rust/Cargo.lock. Do not edit by hand. -->

SudachiSwift is licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)). The prebuilt `SudachiSwift.xcframework` is a static library (`libsudachi_swift.a`) compiled from Rust. It contains sudachi.rs, the Rust crates listed below and the Rust standard library, and the Swift package bundles resource files from sudachi.rs. If you ship an app that uses SudachiSwift, include these notices in the app's acknowledgements.

## What this file covers

- **Rust crates**: every crate that `rust/Cargo.lock` resolves as a normal dependency of `sudachi-swift` 0.7.0 for the Apple targets in the XCFramework (`aarch64-apple-ios`, `aarch64-apple-ios-sim`, `x86_64-apple-ios`, `aarch64-apple-darwin`, `x86_64-apple-darwin`, `aarch64-apple-ios-macabi`, `x86_64-apple-ios-macabi`, `aarch64-apple-tvos`, `aarch64-apple-tvos-sim`, `aarch64-apple-visionos`, `aarch64-apple-visionos-sim`). Build-script and dev dependencies and proc-macro crates only run at build time and are not listed. The binary can contain fewer of these crates, because the compiler drops crates the code never uses. Apart from the Rust standard library, it contains no crate outside this list.
- For each crate: version, the license expression declared in its `Cargo.toml`, repository, and the full text of every license or notice file in the published crate (`LICENSE*`, `LICENCE*`, `COPYING*`, `NOTICE*`, `UNLICENSE`, `COPYRIGHT*`, `AUTHORS*`). A crate that ships none of these is marked as such. Identical texts are printed once under [License texts](#license-texts) and linked from each crate.
- [sudachi.rs](#sudachirs), the [bundled resources](#bundled-resources), the [Rust standard library](#rust-standard-library) and the [MPL-2.0 UniFFI crates](#mpl-20-components-uniffi).

Not covered:

- The Sudachi system dictionary (`system_*.dic`, SudachiDict), which you download separately. SudachiDict is licensed under Apache-2.0 and contains parts of UniDic, which is under the BSD 3-Clause license (Copyright (c) 2011-2013, The UniDic Consortium), and, in the core and full dictionaries, NEologd data (see the zip's `LEGAL` for all attributions). If your app ships a `.dic`, include the `LEGAL` and `LICENSE-2.0.txt` files from the dictionary zip in its acknowledgements.
- Tools that only run at build time: cargo-swift, uniffi-bindgen, proc macros and build scripts.

### Regenerating

Run this from the repository root whenever `rust/Cargo.lock` or the `sudachi.rs` submodule changes:

```sh
python3 scripts/generate-third-party-notices.py
```

It runs `cargo fetch --locked` and `cargo metadata --locked` (no build) and needs only Python 3 and cargo. The output is deterministic. `--check` exits with status 1 when the committed file is out of date.

## sudachi.rs

The `sudachi` crate 0.7.0 is compiled into the static library. It is a path dependency on the `sudachi.rs` git submodule (`sudachi.rs/sudachi`), not a crates.io package.

- License: `Apache-2.0`

- License file: `sudachi.rs/LICENSE`: [license text 1](#license-text-1)

## Bundled resources

The Swift package bundles these files from `Sources/SudachiSwift/Resources` into apps as SwiftPM resources:

| File | Origin |
| --- | --- |
| `char.def` | identical to `sudachi.rs/resources/char.def` |
| `rewrite.def` | identical to `sudachi.rs/resources/rewrite.def` |
| `sudachi.json` | identical to `sudachi.rs/resources/sudachi.json` |
| `unk.def` | identical to `sudachi.rs/resources/unk.def` |

Files taken from `sudachi.rs/resources` are distributed under sudachi.rs's Apache-2.0 license ([license text 1](#license-text-1)). sudachi.rs ships no separate notice for them.

`char.def` appears to originate outside sudachi.rs. Its header has the title `Japanese charcter category map` (misspelling included) and the Subversion keyword `$Id: char.def 9 2012-12-12 04:13:15Z togiso $`. The title and layout of that header match MeCab's `mecab-ipadic/char.def` (<https://github.com/taku910/mecab/blob/master/mecab-ipadic/char.def>), whose keyword is a different CVS revision from 2006. That points to MeCab's `char.def`, most likely by way of the `char.def` that UniDic distributes for MeCab. This has not been checked against a UniDic release. The file has no copyright or license text of its own.

## Rust standard library

`libsudachi_swift.a` also contains the Rust standard library compiled for each target: `std`, `core`, `alloc` and the crates they depend on, for example `compiler_builtins`, `panic_unwind`, `unwind`, `std_detect`, `addr2line`, `gimli`, `object`, `miniz_oxide`, `adler2`, `rustc-demangle`, `hashbrown`, `libc` and `cfg-if`.

- License: `MIT OR Apache-2.0`. `compiler_builtins` is `MIT AND Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception AND (MIT OR Apache-2.0)`: it contains code ported from LLVM's compiler-rt and the MIT-licensed `libm`.
- Copyright: The Rust Project Developers (see <https://thanks.rust-lang.org>). Copyrights in the Rust Standard Library are retained by their contributors.
- Repository: <https://github.com/rust-lang/rust> (`library/`)
- License texts: <https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/blob/master/LICENSE-MIT>, <https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/blob/master/LICENSE-APACHE>, <https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/blob/master/COPYRIGHT>
- The exact notices for a given toolchain, including the standard library's own third-party dependencies, ship with it as `share/doc/rust/COPYRIGHT-library.html` under `rustc --print sysroot`.

## MPL-2.0 components (UniFFI)

`uniffi` 0.31.1, `uniffi_core` 0.31.1 and `uniffi_pipeline` 0.31.1 are licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (<https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/>). They are used unmodified from crates.io. As MPL-2.0 section 3.2 requires for distribution in Executable Form, their Source Code Form is available here:

- `uniffi` 0.31.1: <https://crates.io/crates/uniffi/0.31.1> (source archive <https://static.crates.io/crates/uniffi/uniffi-0.31.1.crate>), git <https://github.com/mozilla/uniffi-rs/tree/ec08cf9db85e938c37e2ecb4a5dec5ad4a68f95a/uniffi>
- `uniffi_core` 0.31.1: <https://crates.io/crates/uniffi_core/0.31.1> (source archive <https://static.crates.io/crates/uniffi_core/uniffi_core-0.31.1.crate>), git <https://github.com/mozilla/uniffi-rs/tree/ec08cf9db85e938c37e2ecb4a5dec5ad4a68f95a/uniffi_core>
- `uniffi_pipeline` 0.31.1: <https://crates.io/crates/uniffi_pipeline/0.31.1> (source archive <https://static.crates.io/crates/uniffi_pipeline/uniffi_pipeline-0.31.1.crate>), git <https://github.com/mozilla/uniffi-rs/tree/ec08cf9db85e938c37e2ecb4a5dec5ad4a68f95a/uniffi_pipeline>

`Sources/SudachiSwift/sudachi_swift.swift` is generated by UniFFI's Swift binding generator (`uniffi_bindgen`, MPL-2.0) from its Swift templates. It is distributed in source form in this repository; the generator's source is at <https://github.com/mozilla/uniffi-rs/tree/ec08cf9db85e938c37e2ecb4a5dec5ad4a68f95a/uniffi_bindgen>.
